initialization_invalid: exclude same group from all condition ranking cohorts; retain planned and observed denominators
observed_tip_count: 85deg or explicit tilt_over; report measured count separately
non_tip_early_termination: remaining fall outcome unknown; never credit as a completed nonfall
ranking_first_priority: observed_tip_count plus unknown-fall-trial count (conservative upper bound); equals measured count when no censoring
ranking_second_priority: mean protective STOP total plus residual unavailable seconds
third_priority: equal validation-scaled progress, linear/turn window counts and seconds
reporting: measured falls, unknown counts, rate lower/upper bounds, conservative Wilson interval, observed STOP and ranking STOP separately
uncertainty: bounds handle unavailable outcomes; they do not assert an unobserved fall happened
